Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard Redwood Inference to the Archer vendor portal. To get you fully provisioned we need: 1) a named admin contact, 2) confirmation on SSO preference (SAML vs email invite), and 3) the initial security questionnaire files (SIG and CAIQ).

I can pre-populate your profile with our SIG template if you prefer to review before we mark it complete. I attached a short invite with steps (archer-invite.pdf). Once the account is created, please upload the SIG/CAIQ PDFs to the Evidence tab so our risk team can complete the review.

Quick checklist: 
- Admin contact (name/email)
- SSO? (SAML - provide IdP metadata, or Ok to use email invites)
- Any current SOC 2 Type II report (optional)

If useful I can also share a pre-filled SIG export to speed the process.

Thanks,
